newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CS keeps eye on 15 pct ROE target.
newsitem.headline: CS keeps eye on 15 pct ROE target.

text.p: CS Holding said it is maintaining a goal of achieving a return on equity (ROE) of 15 percent in three years and becoming the most profitable bank in Switzerland, chairman Rainer Gut told shareholders.

"Our objective is to gradually raise our return on equity to 15 percent over the next three years, and to become the top Swiss bank in terms of net profit," Gut said in a speech released before an extraordinary shareholder meeting,
The goal has been set out for some time by CS Holding, which had an ROE of 7.04 pct in 1995.

Regarding profitability, Gut said the group's ROE had consistently been the highest among Swiss banks despite the fact that group capital had risen by 78 percent to 17.4 billion francs between 1990 and the end of 1995, mainly as a result of acquisitions.
The extraordinary shareholding meeting was called for the sole purpose of changing the group's name from CS Holding to Credit Suisse Group as part of its broad restructuring plan.
